Michael Wilbon Takes Leave of Absence From ESPN Due to Health Issues

03 Nov 2026, 01:55 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: www.hollywoodreporter.com

Key takeawaysLong-time sports commentator and *Pardon the Interruption* co-host Michael Wilbon announced that he is taking an indefinite leave of absence from ESPN to address health concerns. In a public statement shared on social media, Wilbon described the decision as taking a "t

Long-time sports commentator and *Pardon the Interruption* co-host Michael Wilbon announced that he is taking an indefinite leave of absence from ESPN to address health concerns.

In a public statement shared on social media, Wilbon described the decision as taking a "trip to the injured list," citing ongoing struggles with multiple health issues in recent months. He noted that these challenges have affected his work on both *PTI* and the network's NBA coverage.

Background and Context

  • Wilbon has co-hosted *Pardon the Interruption* alongside Tony Kornheiser since the sports debate program launched in 2001.
  • During an appearance on Kornheiser’s podcast, Wilbon explained that he missed recent episodes after feeling profoundly exhausted and lifeless.
  • He attributed some of his health difficulties to managing diabetes while dealing with the physical toll of frequent travel and ignored warning signs.

Network and Guest Host Response

ESPN chairman Jimmy Pitaro released a statement offering the network's full support to Wilbon and his family during his recovery, emphasizing his vital role within the broadcasting team.

  • Temporary Replacements: Frequent guest hosts Pablo Torre and Frank Isola are stepping in to co-host *PTI* alongside Kornheiser.
  • NBA Coverage: Other analysts from the network's roster will handle Wilbon's scheduled studio appearances.

Practical Implications and Verification

Viewers looking for updates on *Pardon the Interruption* or lineup changes can check official programming schedules on ESPN or monitor announcements directly through the network's verified media channels and press room.
